2607.09253.title: LLMs for health: Perceived benefits, risks, intention to use AI chatbots, and willingness to self-disclose across sensitive health topics
2607.09253.paper_summary: AI chatbots are increasingly used for answering health-related questions. This study examines the role of topic type discussed with an AI chatbot and individual characteristics on perceived benefits and risks, intention to use an AI chatbot, and willingness to self-disclose health information. We conducted an online experiment with a 2 (topic type: physical versus psychological, between-subjects) x 2 (topic sensitivity: low versus high, within-subjects) mixed design among a Dutch representative sample (N = 1,388). Results showed that perceived benefits were positively associated with intention and willingness to self-disclose, while perceived risks were negatively associated. Moreover, participants reported higher usage intentions for low-sensitive topics compared to high-sensitive topics. Furthermore, perceptions, intention, and willingness to self-disclose varied by individual characteristics. Overall, our findings suggest that intentions to use AI chatbots and self-disclosure of health-related information are primarily related to perceived benefits and risks and to personal characteristics rather than to topic type.
2607.09253.paper_summary_zh: AI 聊天機器人越來越多地用於回答與健康相關的問題。這項研究探討了與 AI 聊天機器人討論的主題類型和個人特徵對感知利益和風險、使用 AI 聊天機器人的意圖以及自我披露健康信息的意願的影響。我們在一個荷蘭代表性樣本（N = 1,388）中進行了一項在線實驗，採用 2（主題類型：身體與心理，受試者間）x 2（主題敏感性：低與高，受試者內）混合設計。結果顯示，感知利益與意圖和自我披露的意願呈正相關，而感知風險則呈負相關。此外，參與者對低敏感主題的使用意圖高於高敏感主題。此外，感知、意圖和自我披露的意願因個人特徵而異。總體而言，我們的研究結果表明，使用 AI 聊天機器人的意圖和健康相關信息的自我披露主要與感知利益和風險以及個人特徵有關，而不是與主題類型有關。
